pages.speaker: npc
lines: The Timer Ball world really well for catching powerful Pokemon that can heal themselves.

action: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run tellraw @s[tag=ItemLoot70] {"text":"You have already claimed this loot!","italic":true,"color":"gray"}');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run give @s[tag=!ItemLoot70] cobblemon:timer_ball 3');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run tellraw @s[tag=!ItemLoot70] {"text":"You received 3 Timer Balls!","italic":true,"color":"gray"}');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run playsound itemget ambient @s[tag=!ItemLoot70] ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run tag @s[tag=!ItemLoot70] add ItemLoot70');
